title: Deep Learning Notes
deck: The maths of deep learning, one summary sheet per topic. Personal notes I took in 2019 during the Deep Learning Specialization by deeplearning.ai, first written as Observable notebooks.

notes.title: Logistic regression
notes.summary: The simplest network, a single unit: prediction, loss, cost and the gradient descent derivatives, then L2 regularisation.

notes.title: Deep neural networks
notes.summary: Notation, the neuron and its activation functions, forward propagation, cost, backward propagation and gradient descent.

notes.title: Regularisation and optimisation
notes.summary: L2 and inverted dropout, then mini-batch gradient descent, momentum, RMSprop and Adam.

notes.title: Batch normalisation and softmax
notes.summary: Normalising inputs and activations, and the softmax output for multi-class classification.

notes.title: Structuring machine learning projects
notes.summary: Train, dev and test distributions, error analysis and choosing a metric.
